After over a decade of electrification in China's automotive market, and with Huawei's five "realms" setting a precedent, how will the Qijing brand, a deep collaboration between Huawei and GAC, carve out its niche? items.title: 趋境开源框架 KTransformers 成主流大模型首选，Qwen、Kimi、智谱 AI 推荐，单卡跑万亿模型
items.raw_excerpt: 全球头部开源模型方的共同选择，印证了一款底层框架的硬实力。趋境科技与清华共同开源的KTransformers，已成为Qwen、Kimi、智谱AI等多个主流大模型发布首日的推荐推理引擎，其工程实践与兼容性也被多家一体机产品线采纳，成为被开发者、厂商与开源社区广泛复用的共建式底层框架。 技术与生态双认可：成功入选 “计算机系统领域奥斯卡” SOSP 2025 KTransformers 是一个高性能异构推理框架，专注于高效利用底层 GPU、CPU、内存等多样化算力，让大模型在更低算力、更灵活的硬件架构上高效运行。其论文《KTransformers: Unleashing the Full Potential of CPU/GPU Hybrid Inference for MoE Models》成功入选 “计算机系统领域奥斯卡” SOSP 2025，该顶会过去几十年间见证了虚拟化、分布式文件系统等无数里程碑式技术成果的首次亮相，此次入选标志着 KTransformers 的技术实力获得全球顶尖认可。 11月6日，月之暗面发布Kimi-K2-Thinking 模型后，KTransformers迅速完成全面适配，支持用户在单卡环境下完成推理任务，2卡环境下完成LoRA微调任务，大幅降低部署与定制化门槛。同时，趋境科技也已完成该模型在昇腾NPU上的全面适配，提供完善的全国产化推理解决方案，进一步拓宽其应用场景。 推理与微调双高效：KTransformers+SGLang实现高性能推理部署 在推理部署层面，KTransformers与主流推理框架SGLang于10月达成合作，双方架构合入同一分支。在Kimi-K2-1TB的模型推理任务中，用户仅需简单安装SGLang与KTransformers CPU内核，下载官方模型及量化权重，即可通过一条命令启动服务，且仅需单张消费级 GPU+CPU

excerpt_i18n.en:
KTransformers, jointly open-sourced by Converge Technology and Tsinghua University, has become the recommended inference engine for major large models like Qwen, Kimi, and Zhipu AI on their release days. Its engineering practices and compatibility have been adopted by multiple all-in-one product lines, making it a widely reused collaborative underlying framework by developers, manufacturers, and the open-source community.

Technically and ecologically recognized, KTransformers was successfully selected for SOSP 2025, known as the "Oscar of computer systems." It is a high-performance heterogeneous inference framework focused on efficiently utilizing diverse computing resources such as GPUs, CPUs, and memory, enabling large models to run efficiently on lower computing power and more flexible hardware architectures. Its paper, "KTransformers: Unleashing the Full Potential of CPU/GPU Hybrid Inference for MoE Models," was accepted into SOSP 2025, a top conference that has witnessed the debut of numerous milestone technologies like virtualization and distributed file systems over the past decades, marking global top-tier recognition of KTransformers' technical strength.

excerpt_i18n.es: Los principales modelos de código abierto a nivel mundial eligen conjuntamente, lo que demuestra la solidez de un marco subyacente. KTransformers, desarrollado en colaboración por Converge Technology y la Universidad Tsinghua, se ha convertido en el motor de inferencia recomendado en el día de lanzamiento de múltiples modelos principales como Qwen, Kimi y ZhiPu AI. Su práctica de ingeniería y compatibilidad han sido adoptadas por varias líneas de productos integrados, consolidándose como un marco subyacente colaborativo ampliamente reutilizado por desarrolladores, fabricantes y la comunidad de código abierto. Reconocimiento dual en tecnología y ecosistema: seleccionado con éxito para SOSP 2025, el "Óscar de los sistemas informáticos". KTransformers es un marco de inferencia heterogéneo de alto rendimiento, centrado en el uso eficiente de las GPU subyacentes.
